question: Why is it that the kinetics of elimination of most drugs are pseudo-linear or first order ?:

options.opa: The doses used in therapy are less than the maximum speed.
options.opb: Therapeutic concentrations are usually higher than the Michaelis constant (Km).
options.opc: The maximum speed is less than Km.
options.opd: The concentrations used in therapy of most drugs are much lower than the values ​​of Km.
